description: Create a Ujeebu account (and get an API key) for your human, without a key. Works in an unauthenticated session. Ujeebu emails a confirmation link to the address: a human must open it and click Confirm; you cannot confirm it yourself, so tell your human to check their inbox. The response contains request_id and poll_token: keep both and call ujeebu_signup_status about every 10 seconds until status is confirmed (or expired/declined). Requests expire after 24 hours. If the email already has a Ujeebu account, the owner gets an approval email instead; the flow is the same from your point of view (a new key is returned once approved). New accounts start on a free trial.

agent.description: Optional: your agent or app name, e.g. 'Claude Code'. Shown to the human in the confirmation email. Defaults to the MCP client name.

email.description: Email address of the human who will own the account. They must be able to open the confirmation email.

purpose.description: Optional: one short sentence on what the account will be used for (shown to the human).

name: ujeebu_signup
